title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-controls-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Priya Raman
description:
Motivation: Improve observability and tuning surface for Dedicated autoscaler burst controls. Operators need clearer signals for when burst capacity is consumed, how smoothing and token-bucket parameters affect throughput, and per-fleet utilization trends to avoid SLA regressions. This PR introduces enhanced reporting, additional telemetry labels, and a small behavioral change to ensure the token-bucket smoothing window emits an explicit metric so dashboards and alerting can rely on a stable signal.

What changed: added per-fleet burst_utilization and burst_capacity_remaining metrics, exported smoothing_window_ms as a metric and taggable label, and surfaced tokenbucket parameters in autoscaler debug logs. Implemented aggregation hooks in the fleet controller to compute 1m/5m/15m burst_utilization percentiles and a new reporting endpoint (/internal/autoscaler/fleet_utilization) used by the Console to build charts. Also added unit and integration tests for metric correctness and a migration to backfill historical utilization for recent fleets (best-effort).

Why this approach: existing signals were noisy and tied to ephemeral allocator state; exposing a stable metric for smoothing_window and percentiles enables SREs to create SLO-aware alerts and for the Optimize product to recommend smoothing profiles per-workload. The new reporting endpoint is intentionally read-only and requires internal auth; it does not change actuator behavior.

Notes: small behavioral change - tokenbucket smoothing now clamps reported smoothing_window_ms to the configured minimum to avoid 0ms edge cases creating division-by-zero in downstream aggregators. This is covered by tests and a migration that rewrites any malformed stored smoothing values.

Rollout plan: feature gated behind rollout flag autoscaler.burst_reporting_v2. Gradual rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48 hours with canary dashboards. No customer-facing API changes.

Checklist:
- [x] Metrics & labels added (prometheus/exporter + Console hooks)
- [x] Aggregation + reporting endpoint implemented
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Docs: internal runbook updated
- [x] Migration/backfill script included
